data.title: Champions League Matchday 3 Odds, Trends & Injuries: Oct 21
data.content:
Inter were missing 4 players, led by captain Lautaro Martínez, El Toro, who faced roughly seven games out with a hamstring strain. Ange-Yoan Bonny was expected to lead the line, with Josep Martínez or Ivan Provedel in goal.

   Inter out: Lautaro Martínez (hamstring), Benjamin Pavard, Curtis Jones, John Stones.
   Shakhtar out:Eguinaldo (shoulder), Alaa Ghram, Maryan Shved (ineligible).
   Shakhtar doubtful:Marlon Santos, Diego Arroyo, Irakli Azarov. [...] The form told a different story. Cristian Chivu‘s Nerazzurri entered Matchday 3 with 0 points after a 2-1 loss at Real Madrid and a 4-3 home loss to Club Brugge, their first-ever run of 4 straight Champions League defeats. Shakhtar, coached by Arda Turan, had 4 points and play their league-phase home games at Stamford Bridge in London. The Miners were winless in 10 games against Italian clubs and had failed to score in 9 of them.

### Inter vs Shakhtar Injuries and Team News [...] Real Madrid out: Rodrygo (ACL and meniscus), Raúl Asencio (tibia stress fracture).
   Real Madrid not expected to feature:Ferland Mendy. Éder Militão returned from a long layoff.
   Leipzig out:Assan Ouédraogo (shoulder), Leopold Zingerle (suspended).
   Leipzig doubtful:Marc Guiu (thigh). Christoph Baumgartner completed full training and rejoined the squad.
